*Last updated: September 2026*


On April 14, 2025, Paychex completed its acquisition of Paycor at $22.50 per share, roughly $4.1 billion in enterprise value. Paycor, founded in May 1990 by Bob Coughlin to provide payroll services to the Cincinnati market, now operates as "Paycor, a Paychex Company." For a student, that one date changes the entire search. As of September 2026,` careers.paycor.com` does not resolve as a host, and all 17 open Paycor-branded requisitions live on[careers.paychex.com](https://careers.paychex.com/early-careers) , alongside 567 other Paychex requisitions. A sweep of all 584 open requisitions found **zero** intern, co-op or student roles, and the employer's own Internships category link returns nothing. But Paychex's Diversity Recruitment Manager states on camera, on the employer's own Early Careers page: "We offer paid summer, fall, and spring internships available in divisions such as HR, sales, IT, and beyond." Three intake seasons a year means a student who checks in September has not missed the cycle.

## What Is a Paycor Internship?


A Paycor internship is now a Paychex internship. Paychex completed its acquisition of Paycor on[April 14, 2025](https://www.paychex.com/newsroom/news-releases/paycor-acquisition-complete) , and Paycor's campus hiring moved with it. The combined entity serves approximately 800,000 customers across the US and Europe, with Paycor continuing as a distinct brand and platform, "Paycor, a Paychex Company," serving over 40,000 businesses. The current program runs paid internships across **three seasons** : summer, fall and spring, in divisions including HR, sales, IT and beyond, with cohort case-study work and a capstone project. Paycor's legacy program (2016 to 2019) ran rotations, grew from 11 interns to close to 40 in one semester, and served over 300 interns in three years. Paychex rates[3.5 out of 5 on Indeed from 2,301 reviews](https://www.indeed.com/cmp/Paychex,-Inc./reviews) , while Paycor rates[3.0 out of 5 from 242 reviews](https://www.indeed.com/cmp/Paycor/reviews) . Since campus hiring now runs through Paychex, the Paychex numbers are the more relevant of the two.


## When Do Paycor Internship Applications Open for 2027–2028?


Paycor's campus hiring has moved to Paychex, and the timing is different from a typical fall-cycle recruiter. Paychex's own Diversity Recruitment Manager confirms three intake seasons: summer, fall and spring. No application window or deadline is published by either company. The Internships category on careers.paychex.com currently returns zero results, which is the accurate present state. The most actionable channel for a student arriving now is Handshake, where Paychex directs students for campus events, plus the Paychex Talent Community. Paychex fiscal years end May 31, so requisition titles carrying "FY28" indicate roles in the June 2027 to May 2028 window, which is where summer 2027 intern seats would sit.

### Why You Must Apply the Week Applications Open


Paychex runs three intake seasons, which means there is no single "miss it" moment the way a fall-cycle employer creates. But the practical constraint is different and just as real: there are zero live intern postings today, the Internships category is empty, and neither Paychex nor Paycor publishes a window or a deadline. That means the race is not against a deadline but against obscurity. The students who get interviews at this company are the ones who are already visible on Handshake, already in the Talent Community, and already at the Paychex booth during the next campus event. Since 463 of 584 current Paychex requisitions are categorized Sales, the company's centre of gravity is commercial. Show up with a finished go-to-market or data analysis project and you are speaking the language of a company that is four-fifths sales, at a moment when most applicants are submitting a resume and hoping.

## What Are the Eligibility Requirements?


Paychex publishes limited formal eligibility criteria. What is known comes from the Early Careers page and from intern testimonials published on the employer's own site:


• **Student status:** "current college student" per Paychex's own Diversity Recruitment Manager, on camera.


• **Divisions:** "HR, sales, IT, and beyond" per the same statement. Documented intern titles include Software Engineering Intern, Talent Enablement Intern and HR Advisor Intern/Co-op.


• **Paid:** "We offer paid summer, fall, and spring internships" per the employer. No figure published.


• **GPA:** not published by either company. No GPA appears on the Paychex Early Careers page, in Paycor's internship article, or in any of the 584 open requisition records.


• **Work authorization / visa sponsorship:** not published. No sponsorship clause exists on the Early Careers page, and no live intern requisition exists to check.


### Does the Paychex Acquisition Change Who Can Apply?


Structurally, no. Paychex's own Early Careers page presents the same open-ended eligibility it always has: current college students, multiple divisions, no GPA floor, no major requirement. What changed is where you apply (careers.paychex.com, not paycor.com), which brand interviews you (Paychex), and which values framework shapes the culture questions (partnership, accountability, integrity, respect, innovation, service). The bar itself did not move; the address did.

## What Is the Paycor Application and Interview Process Like?


The application process has fundamentally changed since the acquisition. Here is the current step-by-step:


1. **Do not start at paycor.com.**` careers.paycor.com` no longer resolves.` paycor.com/company/careers/` returns HTTP 403. All campus hiring runs through Paychex.


2. **Start at[careers.paychex.com/early-careers](https://careers.paychex.com/early-careers) .** This is the Paychex Early Careers hub with named intern video testimonials, the Handshake link, and the Internships category filter.


3. **Bookmark the Internships category link:**[careers.paychex.com/careers/jobs?categories=Internships](https://careers.paychex.com/careers/jobs?categories=Internships&page=1) . It currently returns nothing. That is the accurate present state, and it is the first place a new posting will appear.


4. **Follow Paychex on[Handshake](https://app.joinhandshake.com/emp/employers/13288) .** The employer's own instruction: "Check out our upcoming events via Handshake!" For a campus-recruiting employer with no published deadline, campus events are the highest-signal channel.


5. **Join the[Paychex Talent Community](https://careers.paychex.com/careers/talentcommunity/form)** for job alerts.


6. **Learn the fiscal-year prefix.** Paychex titles some requisitions "FY27." Its fiscal year ends May 31, so FY27 is June 2026 through May 2027 and a Summer 2027 seat sits in FY28. Watching for FY28-prefixed early-career postings is a concrete tell.


Neither Paychex nor Paycor publishes an interview process. No stage count or format is asserted here. Our[HireVue question guide with a free AI mock tool](https://www.extern.com/post/hirevue-interview-questions-2025-free-ai-mock-tool) covers the behavioral-question pressure common to mid-market employer screens.

## How Do You Stand Out at a Company That Just Changed Its Entire Campus Pipeline?


Three moves, all executable now. First, apply through Paychex, not Paycor. This is the whole game. Every student who lands on paycor.com/careers and bounces is a competitor who gave up. You go to careers.paychex.com/early-careers, bookmark the Internships category, and set a Handshake alert. Second, learn the fiscal-year prefix. Paychex titles requisitions with "FY27" or "FY28"; FY28 is where summer 2027 seats sit. Spotting that prefix the day it appears puts you ahead of every candidate who waits for the posting to surface on LinkedIn. Third, name the values. A Paychex employer-brand manager lists them on camera: partnership, accountability, integrity, respect, innovation and service. Prepare a story for two of them. And remember: 463 of 584 open requisitions are Sales. Whatever your major, an internship at this employer will sit in a company whose centre of gravity is commercial. Say something intelligent about what HCM means and who buys it.

## FAQ


### Can I still apply for a summer 2026 Paycor internship?


No, and the bigger change is that Paycor no longer runs its own campus pipeline. Paychex acquired Paycor on April 14, 2025 at $22.50 per share, roughly $4.1 billion in enterprise value, and Paycor now operates as "Paycor, a Paychex Company." The careers.paycor.com subdomain does not resolve, and every Paycor requisition posts on careers.paychex.com. The student entry point is now careers.paychex.com/early-careers, and the Internships category link is the first place new postings will appear.


### Are Paycor/Paychex internships paid?


Yes. Paychex's Diversity Recruitment Manager states on the company's own Early Careers page: "We offer paid summer, fall, and spring internships." Paycor's 2019 article was titled "Paid Internships: Why College Students Choose Paycor." Neither company publishes an hourly or salary figure, and no live intern requisition exists to check. When intern postings appear, the pay range should be visible on the requisition.


### When do Paychex/Paycor internships open?


No application window is published. Paychex runs paid summer, fall and spring intakes, so three shots per year rather than one. Bookmark careers.paychex.com/careers/jobs?categories=Internships&page=1, join the Talent Community, and follow Paychex on Handshake for campus events. Watch for FY28-prefixed postings, which cover the June 2027 to May 2028 window.


### Where are the internships located?


Not fixed. Paycor's home base is Cincinnati, Ohio, where it was founded in 1990 and where "Paycor, a Paychex Company" has opened a new downtown office. Paychex's is Rochester, New York. Historic Paychex intern reviews come from Henrietta NY and Kennesaw GA. Remote intern roles have existed; a Paychex intern testimonial discusses working remotely, and "Remote" is the largest location bucket in Paychex's own employee video library.


### What departments hire interns?


Paychex names "HR, sales, IT, and beyond," and its published intern roles include Software Engineering Intern, Talent Enablement Intern and HR Advisor Intern/Co-op. Paycor's 2019 program spanned product, marketing, finance, IT and legal. Worth knowing: 463 of 584 currently open requisitions at the combined company are categorized Sales, so this is a commercially weighted organization.


### Does Paychex convert interns to full-time?


No conversion rate is published. A Paychex HR Advisor Intern says on the company's own page that the internship "can either help you possibly secure a job at Paychex after the internship, or diverse yourself from the rest of the candidates for whatever job you're going to apply to." The program's stated design goal is to "help interns thrive in their careers no matter where they choose to work in the future," which is deliberately not a conversion promise. Paycor's 2019 article said it hired 40+ recent grads that year, but that predates the acquisition.


### What is the difference between Paycor and Paychex now?


Paychex is the parent. Paycor continues as a distinct brand and platform serving over 40,000 businesses, while the combined group serves approximately 800,000 customers across the US and Europe. For a job seeker the practical difference is smaller than it looks: both post through the same iCIMS board at careers.paychex.com, and the Internships category filter covers both.


Paycor's campus pipeline has moved to Paychex, and the combined company runs three intake seasons with nothing open today. Use the lead time: a[remote Externship](https://www.extern.com/externships) produces the go-to-market, analytics or financial modeling artefact that makes a Handshake conversation land when the next posting goes live.
